articles.headline: Seven games, seven points: Man United are sleepwalking to another lost season
articles.description: Manchester United were already suffering from their worst start to a Premier League season since 1986. A 1-1 draw with Leeds won't help.
articles.headlineJa: 7試合で勝ち点7：マン・Uはまたしても、望みのないシーズンへと向かっている
articles.descriptionJa: マンチェスター・ユナイテッドは、すでに1986年以来となるプレミアリーグ最悪の開幕に苦しんでいた。リーズとの1-1の引き分けも、状況の好転には繋がらなかった。
articles.body:
Manchester United are slipping toward another season of irrelevance, and it seems only a matter of time before the Old Trafford malaise costs manager Michael Carrick his job.

Ruben Amorim was fired within 24 hours of a 1-1 draw at Leeds United last season -- a dismissal accelerated by an explosive postmatch news conference in which he criticized director of football Jason Wilcox.

Carrick is unlikely to suffer the same fate this week after his squad settled for another 1-1 draw against Leeds on Sunday, but after just one Premier League win all season, and no victories in any competition since beating FK Sabah 4-0 in the Champions League on Sept. 10, the 45-year-old is now entering the danger zone.

We know this because the United death spiral has been played out several times before, and Carrick is beginning to head the same way as his immediate predecessors, Amorim and Erik ten Hag.

A slow start to a season with no sign of improvement followed by a period of drift in the doldrums of mid-table, during which the United hierarchy profess their backing for the manager at the same time as hoping that the problem goes away with positive results.

But it never happens. Weeks and months are wasted, the players maintain their five-out-of-10 performances, results flat-line and eventually, the manager is dismissed and the whole United psychodrama starts again.

Carrick still has support within the United boardroom, but it won't last long if results continue to be as underwhelming as they have been this season.

It is now mid-October, the season is two months old, and United have won just twice -- against promoted Ipswich and the champions of Azerbaijan. They are also out of the Carabao Cup, falling at the first hurdle for a second successive season.

After seven games, United have seven points and are already 14 points behind the leaders, Manchester City. This is United's worst start to a season since 1986, so there are literally no positives for Carrick to cling to.

With proven Premier League managers including Eddie Howe, Antonio Conte and Kieran McKenna all out of work and available for hire, United have options should they press the eject button on Carrick, who was given a two-year contract in May as a reward for guiding the team back into the Champions League after replacing Amorim on a short-term basis in January.

So how long will the club wait? History shows that United never rush into a managerial change, but this season is already slipping away and it will disappear down the sink-hole unless something changes very quickly.

Carrick at least tried to spark a change of fortune by adopting a three-man defence at Elland Road and a more solid midfield with Andrey Santos and Carlos Baleba playing behind Bruno Fernandes and Youri Tielemans.

articles.headline: Jordan Henderson not giving up on England after Chelsea revitalisation
articles.description: Jordan Henderson has not given up on extending his England career after insisting he will use a new lease of life at Chelsea to prove he can still perform at the highest level.
articles.headlineJa: ジョーダン・ヘンダーソン、チェルシーでの復活を経てイングランド代表への意欲を失わず
articles.descriptionJa: ジョーダン・ヘンダーソンは、チェルシーでの再起を通じて自身が依然として最高レベルでプレーできることを証明すると主張しており、イングランド代表としてのキャリアを継続する望みを捨てていない。
articles.body:
Jordan Henderson has not given up on extending his England career after insisting he will use a new lease of life at Chelsea to prove he can still perform at the highest level.

The 36-year-old was fuelled by criticism his twilight years were only good for squad development after unkindly being labelled a "cheerleader" for Thomas Tuchel's national team.

Suggestions he was a good person to have in the dressing were raised again when he made his surprise move to Chelsea from Brentford in the summer as the Stamford Bridge side departed away from their model of recruiting younger players with high potential.

Henderson, a Champions League and Premier League winner with Liverpool, made his third start in the 2-0 win at Everton and, after two goals last week, showed his value to Xabi Alonso's side.

He also believes he can still be worth an England place after being overlooked for selection for the recent Nations League matches due to his lack of game time.

"I will always have the desire for England," said the midfielder, with whom Tuchel has kept in contact with since the summer's World Cup.

"I still feel like I can play at the highest level but I have to do a job at Chelsea and put in good performances and wait and see.

"England's always an honour and a big thing for me. If I feel like I'm playing at the highest level of course I would always want to be involved.

"As long as I am playing and feeling good then I would always want to give myself a chance [of a call up].

"Of course, that's up to the manager and the decisions he makes on the squad and everything.

"I have just got to keep putting in good performances and then take it as it comes."

Henderson's role alongside Moisés Caicedo in central midfield has been a significant factor in back-to-back wins with victory at the Hill Dickinson Stadium Chelsea's first Premier League clean sheet since January.

His performances are also dispelling the myth he is there as a role model to enforce squad standards.

"I'm enjoying the challenge. I think a lot of people spoke about the move when I came but for me I've just got to do my talking on the pitch," he added.

"It helps when you're playing with top players around you and I feel like the team's really coming together.

"I don't really think too much about what other people say. I have just as important a role as every other player on the team, I've just got to bring whatever I bring.

"But they also help me as well. It's not all me coming here to help younger players, younger players can also help experienced players. I'm still learning, and I'm still improving.

"There are going to be so many different opinions I just try and use it as fuel, use it as energy, to prove people wrong again.

"I just want to do my business on the pitch. That's where I do the talking really."

articles.headline: Titans CB Taylor inactive against Colts as team seeks first victory
articles.description: Titans cornerback Alontae Taylor is inactive for Sunday's game against the Colts. A team source tells ESPN  it's a coach's decision and not injury-related.
articles.headlineJa: タイタンズのCBテイラー、初勝利を目指す中コルツ戦を欠場
articles.descriptionJa: タイタンズのコーナーバック、アロンテ・テイラーは日曜日のコルツ戦で欠場する。チーム関係者がESPNに語ったところによると、怪我によるものではなく、コーチの判断によるものだという。
articles.body:
INDIANAPOLIS -- Tennessee Titans cornerback Alontae Taylor is inactive for Sunday's game against the Indianapolis Colts, with a team source telling ESPN it's a coach's decision and not injury-related.

Taylor played 99.7% of the defensive snaps in the Titans' first five games of the season. He signed a three-year, $58 million contract ($42 million guaranteed) in March and has 19 tackles and one sack.

Tennessee (0-5) revamped its secondary by adding Taylor and signing free agent cornerback Cor'Dale Flott to a three-year, $45 million deal. Fellow veteran free agent addition Josh Williams, who signed a two-year, $8 million contract in March, will start in Taylor's place.

Williams was activated from injured reserve Saturday. Cornerback Isaiah Oliver was given the game-day elevation from the practice squad.

Tennessee's secondary has only two interceptions this season and the cornerback group has yet to record a pass breakup. The Titans also will be without starting safety Kevin Winston Jr. due to a quad injury against the Colts.

Titans starting defensive tackle Jordan Elliott is also inactive. Elliott missed Friday's practice due to personal reasons and didn't travel with the team.

articles.headline: Michael Carrick on Man United's worst start since 1986: Situation 'doesn't look great'
articles.description: Michael Carrick said Manchester United's situation "doesn't look great" after a 1-1 draw at Leeds left the club in the bottom half of the Premier League.
articles.headlineJa: マイケル・キャリック、マン・Uの1986年以来最悪の開幕について：状況は「芳しくない」
articles.descriptionJa: リーズとの1-1のドローによりマンチェスター・ユナイテッドがプレミアリーグの下位に沈む中、マイケル・キャリックはクラブの状況について「芳しくない」と述べた。
articles.body:
LEEDS, England -- Michael Carrick said Manchester United's situation "doesn't look great" after a 1-1 draw at Leeds left the club in the bottom half of the Premier League and still searching for a first win since August.

United have collected just seven points from their seven league games this season and are now on a run of one win from seven games in all competitions.

The sequence of results means United, who travel to Serie A side Como in the Champions League on Wednesday, are in the middle of their worst start to a season since 1986.

And while he attempted to find positives from the performance at Elland Road, Carrick admitted that United need to emerge from their slump.

"We are not accepting that everything's great, but sometimes you do struggle and you have to find a way through it," Carrick said. "I understand the situation doesn't look great but I have no doubts we can go on a good run.

"We have to find a way through it. There has been a cycle where it can go in different directions, but we are more than capable of winning matches.

"I am not sat here comparing it to any point [in the past], but we know we can do it, we have done it for some time and we feel we are a better group now.

"I am encouraged by a lot of things and I think we can still have a really good season."

- Ogden: Seven games, seven points: Man United are sleepwalking to another lost season

United took the lead in the first half through Bryan Mbeumo, but the home side equalised on 51 minutes when Dominic Calvert-Lewin scored from close range after the visitors failed to clear a corner.

But after a difficult week marred by defender Lisandro Martínez criticising the club hierarchy's lack of summer spending following a Champions League defeat at Atlético Madrid, Carrick said he believed the performance against Leeds heralded a "fresh start."

"It felt like a fresh start today, accepting it and doing something about it," Carrick said. "There was definitely that commitment, it had to be there today.

"I didn't doubt that, I could feel it, the last couple of days has been as good around the group as we have had for quite some time.

"There was definitely and edge to the game, an intensity. I spoke to the boys about the history of what the game is, the territory, what it takes to win here.

"It definitely tests you and it wasn't a perfect performance, but there was a lot in there to show. That didn't surprise me.

"But we are not getting too carried away because we didn't win, but if you keep doing the right things for the right reasons, you get what you deserve in the end."

articles.headline: Texans safety Reed Blankenship suffers concussion vs. Jaguars in London
articles.description: The Houston Texans lost starting safety Reed Blankenship to a concussion in the second quarter of Sunday's game against the Jacksonville Jaguars in London.
articles.headlineJa: テキサンズのセーフティ、リード・ブランケンシップがロンドンでのジャガーズ戦で脳震盪
articles.descriptionJa: ヒューストン・テキサンズは、ロンドンで行われた日曜日のジャクソンビル・ジャガーズ戦の第2クォーター、先発セーフティのリード・ブランケンシップが脳震盪により離脱しました。
articles.body:
The Houston Texans lost starting safety Reed Blankenship to a concussion in the second quarter of Sunday's game against the Jacksonville Jaguars in London.

Blankenship started every game this season after Houston signed him to a three-year, $24 million contract in free agency. He has been up-and-down in coverage, allowing a 76% completion rate when targeted this season.

On Jaguars running back Bhayshul Tuten's 27-yard touchdown reception in the second quarter, Blankenship missed a tackle as Tuten sprinted to the end zone.

Blankenship's backup is M.J. Stewart.

Linebacker Azeez Al-Shaair also was evaluated for a concussion but returned to the field in the second half.

 A.J. Brown, WR, Patriots (ankle): Brown has been activated and is expected to play on Sunday, per Adam Schefter. While he brings upside and likely will see safe volume, it usually takes some time for a player to return to 100% after a high ankle sprain, so temper expectations a bit. articles.headline: Michael Carrick fails to relieve pressure as Man United draw at Leeds
articles.description: Michael Carrick's future as Manchester United's remains far from secure as his team were held to a 1-1 draw by rivals Leeds United on Sunday.
articles.headlineJa: マンUがリーズ戦で引き分け、マイケル・キャリックは窮地から脱せず
articles.descriptionJa: 日曜日に行われたライバル、リーズ・ユナイテッドとの試合が1-1の引き分けに終わり、マンチェスター・ユナイテッドの指揮官としてのマイケル・キャリックの将来は依然として不透明なままです。
articles.body:
Michael Carrick's future as Manchester United's remains far from secure as his team were held to a 1-1 draw by rivals Leeds United in a result that extended the Red Devils' winless run to six matches in all competitions. 

With just six points earned from their opening six games of the campaign, Man United had already registered their poorest start to a Premier League season before making the trip to Elland Road on Sunday.

Their defeat in midweek against Atlético Madrid was overshadowed by defender Lisandro Martínez criticising the Man United hierarchy and specifically director of football Jason Wilcox -- who was in the stands at Elland Road -- for what the Argentina international considered to be a below-par summer transfer window after they finished third last season. 

Martínez apologised for his comments on Thursday and was named in the Man United starting XI against Leeds by Carrick. However, he was replaced by Noussair Mazraoui at halftime.

The visitors took the lead when Bryan Mbeumo diverted Youri Tielemans' low cross beyond Leeds goalkeeper James Trafford 10 minutes before the break, but Dominic Calvert-Lewin pounced on a loose ball to equalise for the hosts in the 51st minute.

The England striker has found the back of the net in six of his last seven home Premier League games, scoring seven goals in that time. Only Erling Haaland (13) has scored more Premier League goals since the start of April than Calvert-Lewin (8).

Leeds fans held high hopes of securing their first home win over Man United in 24 years, but there was little in terms of quality on show from either side in a full-blooded derby clash, but Carrick will have no complaints about his players' application as they matched the hosts' intensity to earn a deserved point.

"There was definitely that commitment -- it had to be there today, I didn't doubt that, I could feel it," Carrick told a post-match news conference. "The last couple of days has been as good around the group as we have had for quite some time. There was definitely and edge to the game, an intensity.

"I spoke to the boys about the history of what the game is, the territory, what it takes to win here. It definitely tests you and it wasn't a perfect  performance but there was a lot in there to show."

Less positive for United, however, is the fact that their one Premier League win registered this season is their fewest after seven games of a top-flight campaign since 1986-87.

Carrick said he understands "the situation doesn't look great."

"We are not accepting that everything's great but sometimes you do struggle you have to find a way through it. "We have to find a way through it. There has been a cycle where it can go in different directions. [We're] more than capable of winning matches. I understand the situation doesn't look great but I have no doubts we can go on a good run."

Information from ESPN's Mark Ogden, Global Sports Research and PA contributed to this story.

articles.headline: Knicks waive Bruce Brown, keep James Wiseman ahead of opener
articles.description: The Knicks are waiving Bruce Brown and keeping James Wiseman on the roster as the team heads into its regular-season opener, sources told ESPN.
articles.headlineJa: ニックス、ブルース・ブラウンを放出、ジェームズ・ウィズマンは開幕に向けて残留
articles.descriptionJa: ESPNが報じたところによると、ニックスはレギュラーシーズン開幕を控え、ブルース・ブラウンを放出する一方で、ジェームズ・ウィズマンをロスターに留めることを決定した。
articles.body:
The New York Knicks waived Bruce Brown and will keep James Wiseman on the roster as the team heads into its regular-season opener.

Brown was one of several players on non-guaranteed deals vying for one of New York's final two available roster spots. Tony Bradley, Ochai Agbaji and Drew Eubanks were all also waived in recent days.

Wiseman appeared in all four of the Knicks' preseason games and impressed in 24 minutes vs. the Toronto Raptors on Tuesday, when he scored 18 points and grabbed 10 rebounds.

 

According to ESPN's Bobby Marks, the Knicks could have kept Brown and Wiseman, but because they are only $3.2 million below their self-imposed hard cap at the second apron, retaining both players would've been difficult.  

Wiseman, 25, will join Karl-Anthony Towns and Andre Drummond in New York's center rotation. The reigning NBA champions lost key reserve big man Mitchell Robinson to the Boston Celtics this past summer via free agency.

The Knicks begin the NBA's regular season Tuesday, when they host the new-look Philadelphia 76ers.

articles.headline: 76ers, needing frontcourt help, convert 7-foot-6 Tacko Fall to two-way contract
articles.description: The 76ers, dealing with injuries in the frontcourt, have converted center Tacko Fall to a two-way contract.
articles.headlineJa: フロントコートの補強を必要とする76ers、7フィート6インチのタコ・フォールとツーウェイ契約を締結
articles.descriptionJa: フロントコートでの怪我に悩まされている76ersは、センターのタコ・フォールをツーウェイ契約に切り替えた。
articles.body:
PHILADELPHIA -- The 76ers have converted center Tacko Fall to a two-way contract, the team announced Saturday.

Last month, the Sixers signed the 7-foot-6 center to an Exhibit 10 deal, and injuries to the frontcourt likely led to Fall getting this spot.

Ariel Hukporti, projected to be the Sixers' backup center, suffered a season-ending right Achilles tear in the preseason. Center Adem Bona, potentially the next man up, has been sidelined with a foot injury, and Dominick Barlow has battled back soreness that kept him out of the preseason.

Fall hasn't played in the NBA since the 2021-22 season, when he was with the Cleveland Cavaliers. This will be his fourth season in the NBA. He played his first two in Boston with new Sixers forward Jaylen Brown.

Fall, 30, most recently played for the Ningbo Rockets of the Chinese Basketball Association.

articles.headline: James, Embiid play 76ers' preseason finale, 'still working on our rhythm'
articles.description: Without VJ Edgecombe, who was held out of Friday night's 125-120 loss to the Celtics, 76ers coach Nick Nurse gave the closest glimpse of what his team may look like this season, including LeBron James and Joel Embiid playing preseason highs in minutes.
articles.headlineJa: ジェームズとエンビード、76ersのプレシーズン最終戦に出場、「まだリズムを掴もうとしているところ」
articles.descriptionJa: 金曜夜のセルティックス戦（120-125で敗戦）を欠場したVJ・エッジコムが不在の中、76ersのニック・ナース監督は、レブロン・ジェームズとジョエル・エンビードがプレシーズン最多の出場時間を記録するなど、今シーズンのチーム像を最も具体的に示す形となった。
articles.body:
PHILADELPHIA -- As the 76ers begin a season with a star-laden roster, center Joel Embiid rejects the narrative that anyone needs to sacrifice for this team to succeed.

"I'm against the concept of sacrificing," Embiid said after Friday's preseason finale. "I think the way I explained it was you do what you do best, and we're going to support you. ... I don't think anybody has to take a back seat."

Albeit without second-year starting guard VJ Edgecombe, who was held out of Friday's 125-120 loss to the Boston Celtics for precautionary reasons, Sixers coach Nick Nurse gave the closest glimpse of what his team may look like this season.

The other active Sixers starters -- LeBron James, Tyrese Maxey, Jaylen Brown and Embiid -- all played preseason highs in minutes and well into the second half. Embiid, who struggled in his last appearance two games ago against the Brooklyn Nets, finishing with six points and eight turnovers, was dominant.​

He scored 27 points, grabbed eight rebounds and added five assists. In the third quarter, he had one of the game's highlights when he threw down an emphatic dunk that drew roars from fans at Xfinity Mobile Arena.

"It's good to dunk. I thought I would never dunk again," Embiid said with a smile. "I guess I don't know what happened. I kind of got possessed."

Still, the group never looked comfortable together on the floor, despite playing against Celtics reserves. After the game, players didn't shy away from their somewhat disjointed performance. Brown pointed to the team's spacing Friday night, which he said led to turnovers, as one of the many things they need to fix moving forward.

"We're not where we want to be yet," he said. "So that's just a part of it. It's a part of coming together, a new group with a bunch of guys, different style, but we just got to keep getting better every day."

James echoed Brown's comments, but neither seemed concerned about the Sixers' ability to eventually jell.

"We're getting there," James said. "I mean, obviously we are a couple of weeks in, so we're still working on our rhythm, working on our kinks, and it's not going to be perfect."

The Sixers open the regular season against the New York Knicks on Tuesday.

articles.headline: No. 1 pick AJ Dybantsa injures ankle during Wizards' preseason finale
articles.description: First overall pick AJ Dybantsa exited the Wizards' preseason finale after injuring his ankle on an awkward landing and will undergo further evaluation.
articles.headlineJa: ドラフト1位指名のAJ・ディバンツァ、ウィザーズのプレシーズン最終戦で足首を負傷
articles.descriptionJa: 全体1位指名のAJ・ディバンツァが、ウィザーズのプレシーズン最終戦で不自然な着地により足首を負傷して途中交代した。今後、詳細な検査を受ける予定。
articles.body:
First overall pick AJ Dybantsa exited the Washington Wizards' preseason finale Friday after injuring his ankle on an awkward landing and will undergo further evaluation.

Wizards coach Brian Keefe told sideline reporter Chase Hughes that Dybantsa had suffered a mild ankle sprain but that the decision to keep him out for the rest of the game was more precautionary.

"We'll look at it more when we get more information," Keefe said.

Dybantsa fell to the ground after landing on his left ankle following a midrange jump shot before limping to the locker room. He had scored 12 points in 15 minutes before his exit in the second quarter.

The Wizards open the regular season Wednesday against the Milwaukee Bucks.
